business_problem: Mindvalley needed to scale personalized AI learning companions for a large active-user base while keeping latency, uptime, and compute costs under control across customer-facing conversational workloads.
solution_summary: Mindvalley deployed a multi-agent learning ecosystem on Google Cloud to personalize onboarding, content discovery, and in-course tutoring. Goals AI handles conversational onboarding, EVE helps users discover the right catalog content and growth paths, and a Learning Assistant supports coursework. These companions run on Gemini platform and draw on data services built with Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Managed Service for Apache Airflow, and Cloud Run. Cloud SQL hosts the Unified Customer Profile and vector-store context used to personalize responses, while BigQuery supports broader analytics and future graph-based personalization. The architecture gives Mindvalley a reliable, low-latency environment for 1.3 million annual agent requests, nearly doubling weekly engagement while cutting model-compute cost enough to scale further. Google Cloud made personalized conversational learning a core platform capability rather than an add-on feature.

data_flow: User interactions flow into AI companions on Gemini platform, which retrieve profile and vector context from Cloud SQL and operate against data workflows maintained with Airflow and Cloud Run. BigQuery supports analytical insight and future graph enrichment, feeding better personalization back into the companion experience.
business_outcome: Mindvalley nearly doubled AI-companion engagement, increased content interaction, and created a cost-efficient personalized learning platform that can keep scaling to hundreds of thousands of active users.
